apps.scope.label: Current application
apps.scope.required: Select an application from the page header to manage its data.
apps.client_config.title: Client configuration
apps.client_config.unsaved.title: Discard unsaved client configuration?
apps.client_config.unsaved.description: One or more configuration tabs contain unsaved changes. Closing will discard them.
apps.client_config.scanner.runtime_descr: Only absolute HTTPS addresses matching the allowlist can open in the App. This runtime configuration takes effect only after the client refreshes it successfully.
apps.client_config.scanner.enabled: Allow scanned web pages to open in the App
apps.client_config.scanner.enabled_help: When disabled, host entries are retained but every scan result is presented inside the App.
apps.client_config.scanner.allowed_hosts: Supports example.com and *.example.com. A wildcard matches any subdomain depth but not the root. Schemes, paths, IPs, localhost, non-443 ports, and public-suffix wildcards are rejected.
apps.client_config.scanner.host_required: Add at least one allowed domain before enabling in-App web pages.
apps.client_config.scanner.host_invalid: Enter a valid ASCII/Punycode exact domain or wildcard domain.
apps.client_config.scanner.empty_hosts: No allowed domains have been added.
apps.client_config.scanner.load_error: Scanner configuration could not be loaded.
apps.client_config.scanner.save_error: Scanner configuration could not be saved. Check the input and try again.
apps.client_config.scanner.conflict: Someone else updated this configuration. The latest version has been loaded; review your changes again.
apps.feedback.load_error: Could not load App management data. Try again.
apps.feedback.save_error: Could not save the change. Try again.
apps.feedback.validation_error: Check and correct the form fields.
apps.feedback.conflict: Another administrator changed this application. Refresh and try again.
apps.application.title: Application management
apps.application.description: Create and configure independent mobile application boundaries for the current workspace.
apps.startup.bundle_export_hint: Export the bundled startup snapshot before releasing the App. Saving here does not change the first-run privacy screen in an installed build.
apps.startup.feedback.asset_rejected: An image has not passed scanning or is not JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
apps.startup.feedback.published: A new onboarding version was published.
apps.startup.fields.subtitle: Startup subtitle
apps.startup.image_required: Choose an image that passed scanning
apps.startup.publish.description: All localized images will be validated and copied into an immutable version. Users who completed an older version will see this one.
apps.startup.publish.title: Publish a new onboarding version?
apps.application.columns.name: Application
apps.application.delete.title: Delete the selected applications?
apps.application.delete.description: Only disabled, non-default applications can be deleted. Batch deletion is all-or-nothing.
apps.application.fields.appid_hint: Immutable after it is set, for example __UNI__APPKERNIA.
apps.application.fields.name: Application name
apps.application.fields.uuid_list_hint: Enter one UUID per line. Team metadata does not change RBAC authorization.
apps.application.validation.appid: AppID may contain only letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens.
apps.users.title: App user management
apps.users.description: Only people explicitly associated with the current application are listed; shared account infrastructure still owns identity.
apps.users.avatar_self_managed: Users manage their own avatar in the mobile app.
apps.users.fields.password_hint: At least 12 characters; it is never shown again after saving.
apps.users.password_reset.title: Reset App user password
apps.users.password_reset.description: Set a new sign-in password for “{name}”. The server applies its security policy to existing mobile sessions.
apps.users.confirm.enable.title: Enable this user?
apps.users.confirm.enable.description: This allows “{name}” to use the current application.
apps.users.confirm.disable.title: Disable this user?
apps.users.confirm.disable.description: This blocks “{name}” from using the current application.
apps.users.confirm.unlock.title: Unlock this user?
apps.users.confirm.unlock.description: This clears the sign-in lock on “{name}” .
apps.users.confirm.reset-password.title: Reset this user's password?
apps.users.confirm.reset-password.descri: This starts a secure password reset flow for “{name}” .
apps.users.confirm.revoke-sessions.title: Revoke mobile sessions?
apps.users.confirm.revoke-sessions.descr: The current application's mobile sessions for “{name}” become invalid immediately.
apps.pages.title: Single pages
apps.pages.description: Maintain bilingual drafts, publishing, and revision history for legal, About, and custom pages.
apps.pages.reserved_hint: A core page identifier cannot be changed or deleted.
apps.pages.columns.title: Title
apps.pages.fields.title: Title
apps.pages.fields.blocks_hint: Only heading, paragraph, quote, code, image, list, and divider blocks are supported.
apps.pages.feedback.save_before_publish: Edit and save the complete bilingual content before publishing this page.
apps.pages.delete.title: Delete this single page?
apps.pages.delete.description: This deletes “{name}” and its draft content; published revisions remain server-audited.
apps.feedbacks.title: Feedback
apps.feedbacks.description: Review feedback for the selected App, update progress and reply to users.
apps.feedbacks.conflict: This feedback was updated. Your input has been kept; refresh and try again.
apps.public_web.title: Public download page
apps.public_web.promotion_hint: Controls the download link in the header and the promotion after articles and pages. Empty fields use the app name and built-in copy.
apps.public_web.name: App display name
apps.public_web.hint: Platform detection happens on the download page. Stores without a platform and HTTPS URL are omitted; APKs must be published in the upgrade center.
apps.public_web.origin_missing: The server has no public web origin configured. Publishing is unavailable.
apps.public_web.validation: Provide a name and introduction in both languages and check store platforms and HTTPS URLs.
apps.public_web.copy_error: Copy failed. Please copy the link manually.
apps.public_web.not_published: Only published content can be viewed.
apps.public_web.preview_hint: Appearance and size preview only. Platform detection uses your current browser.
apps.public_web.preview_timeout: Unable to confirm page loading. Retry or open it separately.

apps.client_config.login.description: Password sign-in is always available. OTP settings apply to sign-in, registration, and password recovery. Provider access is configured below.
apps.client_config.login.password_help: Enabled by default and cannot be turned off.
apps.client_config.login.channel_require: Enable at least email or SMS when verification code sign-in is on.
apps.client_config.login.load_error: Sign-in configuration could not be loaded.
apps.client_config.login.save_error: Sign-in configuration could not be saved. Refresh and try again.
